tables.description: One row per core number (Life Path, Birthday, Attitude) and value: what the index means, the strengths and weaknesses the site writes for the number, life-area notes for the Life Path, and the classical passages on the number.
One row per Karmic Debt, Pinnacle, Challenge and Personal Year number: the site's meaning of the number in that role and the classical passages on it.
One row per life topic of the numerology classics (work, money, marriage...) for each Life Path number, plus one general row per topic, with the passages.
